more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Methyl glucoside-coconut oil ester is a specified mixture of sugar-derived and coconut-oil-derived ester material. FDA identifies applications that help crystallisation of sucrose and dextrose and provide surface activity in molasses. The molasses application has a maximum of 320 parts per million. The regulation defines the commercial preparation by chemical quality measurements rather than a single molecular formula.
more_info.uses: Used to assist crystallisation of sucrose or dextrose, and as a surfactant in molasses. The US molasses use is limited to 320 parts per million; crystallisation use is limited to the minimum quantity needed for the intended effect.
